1: // Cosmic Collector – concise canvas game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const { width, height } = canvas;
7:   // Create static starfield background
8:   const stars = Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({
9:     x: Math.random() * width,
10:     y: Math.random() * height,
11:     r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
12:   }));
13: 
14:   // ----- Player -----
15:   const player = {
16:     x: width / 2,
17:     y: height / 2,
18:     r: 10,
19:     speed: 2,
20:     fuel: 100,
21:     vx: 0,
22:     vy: 0,
23:   };
24: 
25:   // ----- Game state -----
26:   let score = 0;
27:   const debris = [];
28:   const asteroids = [];
29:   let running = true;
30: 
31:   // ----- Input -----
32:   const keys = {};
33:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
34:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
35: 
36:   function updatePlayer() {
37:     player.vx = (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ? -player.speed : (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ? player.speed : 0;
38:     player.vy = (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) ? -player.speed : (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) ? player.speed : 0;
39:     player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(width - player.r, player.x + player.vx));
40:     player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(height - player.r, player.y + player.vy));
41:     player.fuel = Math.max(0, player.fuel - 0.02);
42:   }
43: 
44:   function spawnDebris() {
45:     const size = 4 + Math.random() * 4;
46:     debris.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, r: size });
47:   }
48: 
49:   function spawnAsteroid() {
50:     const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'x' : 'y';
51:     const obj = {
52:       r: 15 + Math.random() * 15,
53:       speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.0,
54:     };
55:     if (side === 'x') {
56:       obj.x = Math.random() * width;
57:       obj.y = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -obj.r : height + obj.r;
58:       obj.vx = 0;
59:       obj.vy = obj.y < 0 ? obj.speed : -obj.speed;
60:     } else {
61:       obj.y = Math.random() * height;
62:       obj.x = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -obj.r : width + obj.r;
63:       obj.vy = 0;
64:       obj.vx = obj.x < 0 ? obj.speed : -obj.speed;
65:     }
66:     asteroids.push(obj);
67:   }
68: 
69:   function updateObjects(arr) {
70:     for (let i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
71:       const o = arr[i];
72:       o.x += o.vx || 0;
73:       o.y += o.vy || 0;
74:       // Wrap around edges
75:       if (o.x < -o.r) o.x = width + o.r;
76:       if (o.x > width + o.r) o.x = -o.r;
77:       if (o.y < -o.r) o.y = height + o.r;
78:       if (o.y > height + o.r) o.y = -o.r;
79:     }
80:   }
81: 
82:   function dist(a, b) {
83:     const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y;
84:     return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
85:   }
86: 
87:   function checkCollisions() {
88:     // Debris collection
89:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
90:       if (dist(player, debris[i]) < player.r + debris[i].r) {
91:         debris.splice(i, 1);
92:         score++;
93:         // occasional fuel boost
94:         if (Math.random() < 0.2) player.fuel = Math.min(100, player.fuel + 20);
95:       }
96:     }
97:     // Asteroid hit
98:     for (const a of asteroids) {
99:       if (dist(player, a) < player.r + a.r) {
100:         running = false;
101:         break;
102:       }
103:     }
104:     // Fuel out
105:     if (player.fuel <= 0) running = false;
106:   }
107: 
108:   function draw() {
109:     // Background
110:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000020'; // deep space color
111:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
112:     // Stars
113:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
114:     stars.forEach(s => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); });
115:     // Ship (triangle with stroke)
116:     ctx.save();
117:     ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);
118:     ctx.beginPath();
119:     ctx.moveTo(0, -player.r);
120:     ctx.lineTo(player.r, player.r);
121:     ctx.lineTo(-player.r, player.r);
122:     ctx.closePath();
123:     ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
124:     ctx.fill();
125:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#00aaff';
126:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
127:     ctx.stroke();
128:     ctx.restore();
129:     // Debris
130:     ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
131:     debris.forEach(d => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); });
132:     // Asteroids with radial gradient
133:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
134:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
135:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
136:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#333');
137:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
138:       ctx.beginPath();
139:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
140:       ctx.fill();
141:     });
142:     // HUD
143:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
144:     ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
145:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 15);
146:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(player.fuel)}`, 10, 30);
147:     if (!running) {
148:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
149:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
150:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
151:     }
152:   }
153: 
154:   function loop() {
155:     if (!running) { draw(); return; }
156:     updatePlayer();
157:     updateObjects(debris);
158:     updateObjects(asteroids);
159:     checkCollisions();
160:     draw();
161:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
162:   }
163: 
164:   // Spawn intervals
165:   setInterval(spawnDebris, 800);
166:   setInterval(spawnAsteroid, 2000);
167: 
168:   // Start
169:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
170: })();

(End of file - total 170 lines)
